scope: Archive-only working-tree checks before commit; not runtime validation or commercial-quality acceptance.

json.method: json.loads on all Git candidate JSON; includes this report

unity_meta.method: Every candidate Assets file and parent directory has a candidate .meta

sensitive_field_scan.limitation: Heuristic scan; values are never printed in the report.

staged_diff_whitespace.reason: Preserve provider BVH input bytes and provenance hashes exactly. Empty-field whitespace in 7 new Unity .meta files was normalized without changing GUIDs.

unity_compile_and_build.reason: Owner requested archive and push while development remains paused. Latest C# changes postdate the historical Side2D build.

limitations: Uses direct positioning and raises current character HP to 100 for some combat checks.
Does not prove normal-HP full playthrough or compile current source.

quality_status: Prototype and offline experiments; below commercial game/animation quality.
